description.full: Builds new Excel workbooks for you - trackers, registers, logs, lists and simple plans - with dropdowns, automatic IDs, calculated columns, a README and a change log. Just describe what you want to keep track of; I'll suggest the columns. Every workbook is 'AI-safe', so it can be changed later without breaking.
